banner.title: How validation criteria and severity work
banner.description: The rules below define the automated criteria auditing calendar shift assignments. The 'Severity' tag defines how a breach is handled when limits are exceeded: Blocking Error (prevents publication) or Informative Warning (attention alert). It does not indicate a defect in the rule definition.

logicExplanation.title: Trigger Criteria (When it generates an error):
logicExplanation.maxShiftsDay: Triggers when the same staff member is assigned to more than {{count}} shift(s) on the same calendar day (00:00 to 23:59).
logicExplanation.maxShiftsWeek: Triggers when staff accumulates more than {{count}} shift(s) in the same calendar week from Sunday to Saturday.
logicExplanation.maxShiftsMonth: Triggers when staff accumulates more than {{count}} shift(s) in the same month.
logicExplanation.maxHoursDay: Triggers when total working hours on the same day exceed {{hours}}h.
logicExplanation.maxHoursWeek: Triggers when total working hours in the week exceed {{hours}}h.
logicExplanation.maxHoursMonth: Triggers when total working hours in the month exceed {{hours}}h.
logicExplanation.minRest: Triggers when rest time between the end of a shift and the start of the next is under {{hours}}h (e.g., leaving at 19:00 and entering at 07:00 next day yields only 12h of rest).
logicExplanation.consecutiveDays: Triggers when staff works more than {{days}} consecutive day(s) without intermediate rest.
logicExplanation.maxPeoplePerShift: Triggers when more than {{count}} staff member(s) work simultaneously in the same shift or with overlapping hours on that day.
logicExplanation.dailyShiftHoursExact: Triggers when total shift hours for the day differ from exactly {{hours}}h on {{filter}}.
logicExplanation.dailyShiftHoursMax: Triggers when total shift hours for the day exceed {{hours}}h on {{filter}}.
logicExplanation.dailyShiftHoursMin: Triggers when total shift hours for the day are under {{hours}}h on {{filter}}.
